body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-15 18:06Z, learned from w-5656's failed carried gate test-a27d5c04). Focused vitest runs (direct `npx vitest run <file>`) TRANSPILE without type-checking, so a package can pass every focused GREEN and still fail the full gate's typescript stage. On w-5656, ui/src/session-reconcile.test.ts passed an object whose messageCount was number|null|undefined where StateSessionSummary requires number (TS2345), and that cost a ~40 min gate slot. RULE: before freezing ANY package that touches ui/src (TS or TSX, tests included), the producer runs `npx tsc --noEmit` from its root\ui (direct form, workdir root\ui; a warm narrow check on a slot GO) and cites the clean result in the package handoff. Coordinators: ask for it before LAUNCH NOW on UI packages.
